preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 15 for N, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices N is between 1 and 15 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= M < N * (N - 1) // 2 for N, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of edges M is between 0 and N*(N-1)/2 exclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= X <= N and 1 <= Y <= N for N, M, edges in test_cases for X, Y in edges)
preconditions.description: For each edge in each test case, both vertices X and Y are between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and isinstance(y, int) and x > 0 and y > 0 for x, y in results)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output values x and y are positive integers.

postconditions.expression: all(A * x == B * y for (A, B), (x, y) in zip(test_results, results))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output values x and y satisfy the equation Ax = By.

postconditions.expression: all(x == min(x for x, y in results if A * x == B * y) for (A, B), (x, y) in zip(test_results, results))
postconditions.description: For each test case, x is the minimum value satisfying the equation Ax = By.
